name: manfredi
description: Working Claude Code kits from a real agency operator: the scaffold, the sales-call reader, the content engine starter, the AI-tell stripper, and the client onboarding stack. Versioned, and bumped when the model era shifts.

plugins.name: agency-starter
plugins.description: The memory tiers, project scaffold, guard hooks, and 14 working skills I run my agency's Claude Code on. Drops in in about 15 minutes.

plugins.name: drop-point-read
plugins.description: Reads one sales call transcript and names the exact line where the deal slipped, scored against your own best closes.

plugins.name: content-engine-starter
plugins.description: The skeleton of a Claude-run LinkedIn content engine: 6 pipeline prompts, anti-slop checklist, pillars, and the buyer-fit scoring rubric.

plugins.name: strip-ai-tells
plugins.description: A line editor that finds the 14 tells that make AI-written copy obvious and rewrites them out, one pass per draft.

plugins.name: client-onboarding
plugins.description: A skill plus four stage agents that run a signed client from intake form to first deliverables, with the founder as the approve gate.

plugins.name: linkedin-preview
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that shows your LinkedIn post the way the feed shows it, cut at the "see more" fold, with the markdown LinkedIn will not render flagged. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: linkedin-hook-score
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that scores the hook of every LinkedIn draft from 1 to 10 against your own best posts, learned from your LinkedIn exports, with your own Claude. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: linkedin-voice-guard
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that flags the phrases that make a LinkedIn draft sound AI-written, highlighted in their line, and rewrites only those lines on one key. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: linkedin-next-post
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod that offers the next 3 content steps after a LinkedIn draft as one-key buttons: carousel, objection replies, a hook that fits the fold. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.

plugins.name: linkedin-pipeline
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod with a pane of your leads, replies and booked calls, read from your LinkedIn data export or a CRM CSV. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287+.
